name: Open With
description: Open the workspace, or a file link in an agent reply, in Fork, VS Code, Cursor, a terminal, or any app you add. Right-click a file link or image to show it in its folder or copy its path.

zh-CN.description: 用 Fork、VS Code、Cursor、终端或你添加的任何程序，打开 workspace 或 Agent 回复里的文件链接。右击文件链接或图片，可以在文件夹中显示、复制路径。
